title: Jimmy Of The Saints releases his latest single titled “HEATER”
htmlContent:
American-based artist, Jimmy Of The Saints, has continued his streak of heat with another insane sound for his audience. He brings a master class of lyricism and soul to this new record, "HEATER." The record is packed with pure emceeing, with them throwing on a dope beat courtesy of Ohbliv and going for gold for every second.

Hip Hop music is at its best when it has that soul. That particular element makes you feel the music on a spiritual level as you get swept up in the many intricacies of the record that work in perfect harmony to make for a timeless experience. You get this from Jimmy Of The Saints on his new record, "HEATER."
